g.text: The outlined four validate all-pairs under simulated colour-vision deficiency, not merely pairwise-adjacent — take them in order and a four-series chart is safe by construction.
One hue, lightness strictly descending. Opt-in by name — the default ordinal scheme stays viridis.
Each arm lightens toward the midpoint, and the midpoint carries no chroma.
Good, warning, serious, critical — then the null ink, which carries no chroma so it can never be read as a series.
